sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.6546 of 2025

It is stated that petitioner No.1 is the owner and possessor of the land admeasuring Ac.1.10 guntas in Sy.No.238/2/3/1 and petitioner No.2 is the owner and possessor of the land admeasuring Acs.2.28 guntas in Sy.Nos.238/2/3/2, 238/1 and 239/1/2, situated at Chintagurthi Village,
Raghunadhapalem Mandal, Khammam District.

It is further stated that the names of the petitioners were mutated in all the revenue records and they were issued pattadar pass book Nos.T26140052679 (Khata No.60620) and T26140052643 (Khata No.60582), respectively, under the provisions of the Telangana Rights in Land and Pattadar Passbooks Act, 2020 (for short "the Act 9 of 2020").

entities.text: Telangana Rights in Land and Pattadar Passbooks Act, 2020
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further stated that the respondents have taken up the construction work under lift irrigation scheme for laying of water pipe line from Venkatayapalem NSP canal to Manchukonda.

The case of the petitioners is that without acquiring their lands as required under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, the respondents have suddenly changed the pipe line alignment and marked alignment in middle of their agricultural land and without following due process of law, the respondents are also proceeding CVBR, J Wp_6546_2025 to dig canal for laying pipeline, which constrained them to submit a representation dated 06.02.2025 respondent No.2 but no action has been taken on the said representation till date.
2. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties and with their consent, this writ petition is being disposed of at the admission stage.
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Mr. Laxmalla Sandeep, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Irrigation, appearing for the respondents basing on his written instructions, it is submitted that lift irrigation scheme was sanctioned by the Government for an amount of Rs.66,33,00,000/- (Rupees sixty six crores thirty three lakhs only) and the construction work is entrusted to M/s PVRPL & ACCO JOINT VENTURE,
Hyderabad and the said work consists of construction of pump house on the bank of 21st MBC of NSLBC at KM 13.250 near V. Vankatayapalem Village, Raghunandhapalem, Khammam District.

It is also stated that the various lands of the pattedars of the said Mandal are being effected for laying of the pipeline and there is no deviation in the alignment sanctioned by the Government for laying of the pipeline, which would not cause any inconvenience or damage to the agricultural activities.

It is also stated that the respondents will not obstruct the pattadars from CVBR, J Wp_6546_2025 laying of fencing over the subject lands and the Government has undertaken the said scheme to provide water to the drought prone areas of Raghunandhapalem, Khammam District, due to the drop of ground water level in that particular area.

sentences.text: In view of the said submissions, as there is no deviation in the alignment sanctioned by the Government and the works undertaken by the respondents would not cause any inconvenience for cultivation of the lands of the petitioners, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this writ petition directing the respondent authorities to strictly adhere to the approved alignment plan sanctioned by the Government for laying of pipeline.
It is made clear that any deviation of the alignment plan would be viewed seriously by this Court, unless there is approval from the competent authorities.
5. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
6. As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
